# foghorn

> A release notes generator for Claude Code. It writes technical release notes for a tag range: what changed for a user, the old and new output, who is affected and how to check, and credit for the people who helped. A TypeScript checker fails notes that skip these facts. The default voice is foghorn. The checker runs without Claude on Node 22.18 or later.

foghorn has three skills: draft, check and voice. A person reviews every draft. foghorn never publishes.

## Docs

- [Home](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/): what a good release note does, how it works, install, limits
- [Showcase](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/showcase.html): a real run for typescript-patterns-enforcer v0.6.0
- [Voice](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/voice.html): the habits of the foghorn voice, the presets, calibration numbers
- [Guide](https://gagoar.github.io/foghorn/guide.html): commands, checks, config, dependencies, read-only guarantees, privacy, FAQ
